title: Security Center
items: Added the Security Center: Owner, Extra Owner and Trusted Admin tiers control who can change security settings, with a tier lock that is on by default
Added a global whitelist for members, roles and channels with per-system scopes
Added about 200 security settings with set, get, reset, add and remove commands in every security module
Added relaxed, balanced, strict and paranoid presets, plus settings export and import
AntiNuke now has short and hourly limits per action, restores deleted channels and roles, reverts permission escalation, and watches webhooks, vanity URL changes and bot additions
AntiRaid join gate filters each have their own action, with account-age cluster detection and a sweep of recent joins
AutoMod gained scam and IP logger link detection, caps, zalgo, emoji, duplicate and wall-of-text filters with adjustable weights
Verification has attempt limits, lockouts, cooldowns, secure captchas and a fail action
Added server lockdown, backups with restore, a threat score with Beast Mode and the securitycheck command
Fixed quarantine failing the second time a member was quarantined

title: Web dashboard, new site and tickets overhaul
items: Added a web dashboard with Discord sign-in, per-server settings, module search and on/off switches
Dashboard can be switched on or off per server with the dashboard command, and globally by owners
Added an audit log of every change made from the dashboard

Dashboard can now create, edit, post and delete things, not just change settings: ticket panels, giveaways, reaction roles, custom commands, alerts, leveling rewards and multipliers, and moderation actions (warn, mute, kick, ban, unban)
Dashboard can manage embeds (create, edit, copy, rename, send, delete), pick an embed for each greeting, and run 24/7 lofi radio, 24/7 voice mode and custom stations
Commands page shows one category at a time with an All tab, live search, copy buttons and expand or collapse all
Documentation now covers every system, grouped by area, with search, an on-page contents list and copy buttons on commands
Dashboard redesign with a module sidebar, overview stats, on/off/pinned filters, tabbed module pages, sortable lists and better phone layouts
Rebuilt the website with a categorised command list, docs, changelog, team, terms and privacy pages
Tickets now support multiple panels (3 free, 10 premium) and multiple staff roles (10 free, 20 premium)
Added ticket forms, priorities, claiming, subjects, per-panel transcripts, auto-close and statistics
Added NSFW role-gated channels
Ticket welcome messages now ping the opener and staff roles
Fixed a database default that failed on older SQLite versions
